media.title: Ufa-Theater Universum, Berlin — street façade, 1928
media.description: Street view of the curved façade and entrance of the Ufa-Theater Universum in Berlin, published in Mario von Bucovich’s photographic volume Berlin in 1928. The image documents the venue before Bick & Kaper’s documented appearance there in February 1929; it does not depict that performance or constitute evidence of Kaper’s presence in the photographed scene.

timelineEvents.title: Bick & Kaper at Berlin premiere
timelineEvents.label: 1929 · Bick & Kaper at Berlin premiere
timelineEvents.shortDescription: The Bick und Kaper piano duo plays before a Berlin film premiere and attracts press attention.
timelineEvents.longDescription: The Rhein- und Ruhrzeitung of 14 February 1929 reports that the evening at the Ufa-Theater Universum in Berlin, the première of Der Adjutant des Zaren with Ivan Mosjoukine and Carmen Boni, opened with the jazz piano duo Bick und Kaper, “die Jazz auf zwei Flügeln darboten”. The notice adds that their technique was astonishing.

places.publicNote: Historic cinema site at Kurfürstendamm 153, connected with the 1929 Bick & Kaper appearance at the premiere of Der Adjutant des Zaren. The marker identifies the documented venue site, not a position within the former auditorium.
